Five-list version of the United Kingdom data

UKdat_5.Rd

A five-list version of UKdat, constructed by combining the police-force and National Crime Agency lists into a single list, PFNCA.

Usage

UKdat_5

Format

A data frame with 18 rows and 6 columns. Columns LA, NG, PFNCA, GO and GP are binary list-membership indicators. Column count gives the number of cases having each observed capture history.
